data.long_meaning: The name Antoinette is derived from Antonius, a Latin name that means 'priceless one' or 'invaluable'. In French, Antoinette means 'grace given'. The name has been popularized by famous figures such as Antoinette Bourbon, the last queen of France before the French Revolution, and Antoinette Tennant, a British aristocrat and socialite.

in_hebrew.name: אנטואנט
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אנטואנט הוא שם נוצרי שמקורו בלטינית, נגזר מהשם אנטוניוס, שפירושו 'בלתי נמנע' או 'חזק'. השם אנטוניוס היה פופולרי בקרב הנוצרים הקדומים והיה קשור לסנט אנטוני, אחד הקדושים הנוצרים הראשונים. השם אנטואנט הוא גרסה נשית של השם אנטוניוס ומשמעותו 'חזקה' או 'איתית'.

in_greek.name: Αντουανέτ
in_greek.long_meaning: Αντουανέτ είναι η γυναικεία μορφή του ονόματος Αντώνιος, που προέρχεται από το λατινικό Antonius. Το όνομα Αντώνιος συνδέεται με τον Άγιο Αντώνιο, έναν από τους πρώτους χριστιανούς αγίους. Το όνομα Αντουανέτ σημαίνει 'αδύναμη προς την αλλαγή' ή 'ακαταμάχητη' και είναι δημοφιλές στις χριστιανικές κοινότητες.

in_latin.name: Antoinette
in_latin.long_meaning: Antoinette est forma feminina nominis Antonius, qui a latina lingua originem ducit. Nomen Antonius ad Sanctum Antonium, unum de primis christianis sanctis, refertur. Antoinette significat 'inmutabilis' vel 'fortis' et est nomen christianum inter christianas communitates populare.

in_english.name: Antoinette
in_english.long_meaning: Antoinette is a Christian name derived from the Latin name Antonius, which means 'inestimable' or 'priceless'. The name Antonius was popularized by Saint Anthony, one of the earliest Christian saints. Antoinette is the feminine form of Antonius and conveys strength, courage, and spiritual richness. Historically, the name Antoinette has been used across various Christian cultures, symbolizing devotion and faith.

data.cultural_impact: Antoinette is a name with a rich cultural history. In France, it is synonymous with royalty and elegance, as it was the name of Marie Antoinette, the last queen of France before the French Revolution. Her story is one of extravagance, power, and ultimately, the fall of the monarchy. In England, the name Antoinette was associated with the aristocracy, as shown by the prominence of Antoinette Tennant, who was a socialite and a popular figure in British high society during the late 18th and early 19th centuries. The name has a timeless and refined quality that continues to resonate with people today.
data.spiritual_significance: Antoinette is a name that carries with it the grace and beauty of a divine gift. It is a reminder that each of us is precious and valuable in the eyes of God, and that we are all given the gift of life and the opportunity to live it to the fullest. The name also invites us to consider the role of grace and elegance in our spiritual journey, to strive for excellence and refinement in our thoughts, words, and actions, and to embrace the beauty and uniqueness of each moment and experience. Through the name Antoinette, we are called to recognize and honor the priceless value of ourselves and others, and to offer our lives as a living expression of gratitude and grace.
